result.reason: The operative language fully reaches the preferred position by removing Customer’s sole-supplier obligation and expressly preserving Customer’s right to use third-party providers. It makes only targeted changes to Section 2.2, leaves the broader protections in Section 12.3 intact, and preserves the underlying commercial intent that Vendor will provide hosted analytics services. The added minimum-volume clarification is consistent with Section 12.3 and does not introduce an unrelated change. The drafting is clear and professional.
